high_level_description: The image appears to be a slide from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference, as indicated by the logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "What might a cognitive scientist think of OaK?" and discusses the potential insights that reinforcement learning (RL) and Open AI Knowledge (OaK) could provide into various questions within cognitive science. Slide Content: The slide lists several questions that a cognitive scientist might consider regarding RL and OaK: How can high-level knowledge be learned from low-level experience? Where do concepts come from?
